items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: And I love Louis’ stuff. The King Oliver stuff was a little, I don’t think I’d say sloppy, but it was different.

ctx.x: Why in your estimation are those records so different?

It might be because it was such a separation of white and black. And the cool nature of some of the players, which they didn’t call cool at the time, but there was a more melodic kind of approach. And it had to do with race at the time but there were some great, hot players who were white. But to me, Bix, I love that stuff. And I love Louis’ stuff. The King Oliver stuff was a little, I don’t think I’d say sloppy, but it was different. And there was a certain kind of articulation that some of these guys brought…
